            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/watch-rubio-delivers-keynote-address-at-federalist-society-national-lawyers-convention</link>

            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, a ship collided with a river cruise boat in New Orleans, causing it to sink in the Mississippi River, some Microsoft users were offline for a second day as the company scrambled to restore its widely used suite of workplace software and the White House is tightening rules on how staffers interact with lobbyists. ]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/bessent-accuses-lutnick-of-failing-to-prevent-china-from-obtaining-nvidia-chips</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The fallout of Jensen Huang's downfall expanded into a public fight between two of President Trump's top advisers.             <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/increasing-cost-of-housing-squeezes-americans-out-of-market</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Sales of existing homes in the U.S. fell last month to their lowest level in more than 16 years. That's according to a new report by the National Association of Realtors. In October alone, sales dropped to 3.75 million homes, an 8.8% drop compared with the same time last year.             <description><![CDATA[Senate Democrats won back their majority last week, and now they're fighting over who will lead it. Maryland Sen.             <title><![CDATA[ICE touts record number of deportations in agency's history]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/ice-touts-record-number-of-deportations-in-agencys-history</link>
            <description><![CDATA[The Department of Homeland Security reports that immigrant deportations and arrests hit an all-time high. More than 491,000 people were arrested by ICE in the last fiscal year, and more than 483,000 were deported. The Trump administration has said it aims to deport one million immigrants annually. William Brangham discussed more with John Sandweg, who was acting ICE Director under President Obama.]]></description>
